title: Buster Bailey, Redman, Hawkins and the core of the band
summary: Asked how Roy and Chu came in, Thomas says the core of Henderson's band was Redman, Buster Bailey, Hawkins and Henderson and their idea of interpretation.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well, now how did these changes come about when Roy and Chu came in, what was the reason for that? Was Buster Baily in the band before they came in?
Yeah, he was there right along, wasn't he?

Yeah, Buster was, I always thought about Buster, he's a tremendous musician. He had lots of things to do and that was the core of Smacks band was Redman, Buster and Hawk and Smack and I can't remember all of their names, I think Chambers was one of their trumpet players. And they had an idea of how music should be played. Music should be interpreted and it came about in that idea.
Well, what we're coming to -- well, I mean, OK Smack had had a period when he maybe was what you were saying but now when we get to 35 years and Christopher Columbus and he's got a big hit again.
